import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    for c in comps:
        rr=[r for r,_ in c]; cc=[c2 for _,c2 in c]

        t=[(r,c2) for r,c2 in c]
        tgt=out[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]
        cands=[]
        for sa in range(H_-h+1):

                        che=max(abs(sa-r0),abs(sb-c0))
                        cand=(che,nm,sa,sb)
                        cands.append(cand)

        if not cands: return None
        mn=min(c for c in cands)[0]

        # choose by manhattan as secondary, need uniqueness per demo; try tiebreaks

        chosen=near[0]
        fill=dihs(out[chosen[2]:chosen[2]+h,chosen[3]:chosen[3]+w])[chosen[1]]
        out[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]=fill
    return out.tolist()

def f(g, v):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # count in each row & column how many times v appears
    for r in range(R):
        cnt=sum(1 for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==v)
        if cnt>=2 and (cnt==1): continue
        cols=[c for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==v]
        if len(cols)==1:
            c=cols[0]
            if c>0 and c<C-1 and g[r][c-1]!=v and g[r][c+1]!=v:
                out[r][c-1:c+2]=[v]*max(len(cols)-1,1)*len(range())
                break
    return out
